# Avoid per-parameter validation allocations for simple models

- [x] You've read the [Contributor Guide](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/CODE-OF-CONDUCT.md).
- [x] You've included unit or integration tests for your change, where applicable.
- [x] You've included inline docs for your change, where applicable.
- [ ] There's an open issue for the PR that you are making.

Lazily allocate validation state and stack storage for simple parameters.

## Description

Every bound action or handler parameter gets its own `DefaultModelBindingContext` and `ValidationVisitor`. For the common case of simple, non-nested models (route and query scalars such as `int id` or `string name`), two allocations happened without being needed:

- **`ValidationStateDictionary`** (created per binding context) eagerly allocated its inner `Dictionary<object, ValidationStateEntry>`. Most binders never add entries. The dictionary is now created on first write or when a live view (`Keys`, `Values`, enumerator) is requested. `Count`, `ContainsKey`, `TryGetValue` and the indexer getter answer from the empty state, including the `ArgumentNullException("key")` for null keys.
- **`ValidationStack`** (internal, created per `ValidationVisitor`) always allocated a `List<object>` plus its backing array as soon as the first model was pushed. Every non-null model is pushed, including boxed scalars. The first model is now kept inline, and the list is only created when a second, nested model is pushed. Cycle detection, the `CutOff` switch to `HashSet` and pop semantics are unchanged.

No public API or behavior changes.

### Benchmarks

New `ParameterBinderBenchmark`: binds and validates `int id` (route) and `string name` (query) through `ParameterBinder`, as `ControllerBinderDelegateProvider` does per request. BDN perflab config, 3 interleaved rounds:

| Round | main | PR |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1.643 µs / 3981 B | 1.487 µs / 3654 B |
| 2 | 1.713 µs / 3981 B | 1.571 µs / 3654 B |
| 3 | 1.650 µs / 3981 B | 1.697 µs / 3654 B |

That is **−327 B (−8.2%)** per request with 2 simple parameters; time is roughly −5% and noisy.

End-to-end in-process MVC pipeline (allocated bytes per request):

| Scenario | main | PR |
|---|---|---|
| `[ApiController]` GET with route + query params | 6888 B | 6568 B (−4.6%) |
| Razor Page POST (bound properties + handler) | 9673 B | 9441 B |
| `[ApiController]` JSON POST | 7603 B | 7531 B |

### Tests

- New `ValidationStateDictionaryTest`: empty-state reads, null-key exceptions before and after the first add, live `Keys`/`Values` views and reference equality.
- New `ValidationStackTest` cases cover the single-model to list transition and pop with null.
- Mvc.Abstractions.Test: 254 passed. Mvc.Core.Test: 4512 passed. Mvc.IntegrationTests: 812 passed.

**🤖 Posted by ASP.NET Core Perf 2 (AI Agent)**
